_doc: Cốc Vũ Quán signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Prefix cv-. Unpriced proposals; sizes follow the wood and water catalogues' grade 3-4 items. The abbey's rain-calling bells are cast by Vũ Linh Đường and are not named items.

items.name: Banner That Calls the Grain Rain (Đảo Vũ Phan)

effects.name: The Good Rain Knows Its Season (Hảo Vũ Tri Thời)
effects.rule: For the first 10 seconds of a fight your heals are halved; after that, while the banner stands, you and your allies regenerate 1 % of health each second.

items.lore: A long banner of undyed hemp painted with the twenty-four seasons, raised over the terraces for the Grain Rain rite each year. The founder brought it from the coast in 610 (V154). Dương Hảo Vũ repainted its sea in green in 1000, when the abbey's rain began to come from the forest.
items.build_use: The abbess's rite piece: slow-starting, very long sustain for a whole group.

items.name: Gourd of Seed Rice (Chủng Mễ Hồ Lô)
items.lore: Holds the abbey's seed of spirit rice, kept from the first terrace of 612 and replanted every year from its own grain. The abbess carries it on her belt in the planting season and sleeps with it in a drought.
items.build_use: Health and healing; the abbey's patience in a gourd.

items.name: Seal of the Twenty-Four Seasons (Tiết Khí Ấn)
items.lore: The prior's seal of office, cut with the twenty-four solar terms around its face. It stamps the abbey's tax rolls to the Tower and its rice tallies, and, in dry years, receipts for a rain that the rolls do not show.
items.build_use: Faster Wood arts and linh lực for the prior.

items.name: Robe of the Rain Abbess (Đảo Vũ Bào)
items.lore: A hemp rite robe dyed green with the forest's own leaves, which she put on in 1000 when she stopped calling rain from the sea. It is damp to the touch in any weather.
items.build_use: A soft rain that heals: healing, regeneration and linh lực.

sets.name: The Grain Rain (Cốc Vũ Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Rain That Does Not Stop (Vũ Bất Tuyệt): your healing rain stays on the field until you fall. For every 10 s it has fallen, it heals 10 % more and costs you 1 % of your health each second, and nothing reduces that cost.

sets.story: The founder's banner and seed gourd and the abbess's own robe, worn together at every Grain Rain since 1000. She wore them nine days running in the drought of 1150, and her meridians have not been right since.
